claim: Chrome 127+ app-bound encryption breaks all external cookie extraction; Firefox SQLite is the only working method in 2026
quote: Chrome 127+ introduced app-bound encryption. The decryption key is now bound to the Chrome binary itself.

claim: OAuth (username/password and device code) no longer works; cookies are required; rate limits are ~2000/hr authenticated vs ~300/hr guest
quote: logging in via OAuth...no longer works with yt-dlp Extractors. Users must use Cookie-Based Authentication instead.

claim: Watch Later is a system-managed RelatedPlaylist; update/delete/reorder operations return 403 or 404; insert and list work
quote: Some playlists, such as the user's watch history or watch later playlist, are system-managed and cannot be modified by API requests.

claim: APISID/SAPISID (and __Secure-3PAPISID if present) are the required cookies for InnerTube authentication; other cookies may be present but are not strictly required
PO tokens are required for GVS, Player, and Subs contexts; generated by BotGuard (Web), DroidGuard (Android), iOSGuard (iOS); YouTube Premium accounts skip GVS tokens
quote: A PO Token is generated by an attestation provider on Web, Android and iOS platforms to attest the requests are coming from a genuine client.

claim: SAPISIDHASH is constructed from SAPISID cookie + timestamp + origin via SHA1 hash
quote: SAPISIDHASH (this value is generated using the SAPISID cookie)

claim: Cookies should be extracted from a private/incognito window and the tab closed immediately to prevent rotation
PO tokens bind to DATASYNC_ID for authenticated GVS, VISITOR_DATA for unauthenticated GVS, and VIDEO_ID for Player and Subs contexts
quote: Authenticated GVS requests use DATASYNC_ID, while unauthenticated GVS requests bind to VISITOR_DATA. Both PLAYER and SUBS contexts bind to VIDEO_ID regardless of authentication.

claim: When logged out, PO tokens bind to Visitor ID from VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE; when logged in, they bind to account Session ID
quote: When logged out, tokens bind to a Visitor ID from the VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE cookie. When logged in, tokens bind to the account Session ID instead.

claim: Using yt-dlp as a Python module to download Watch Later (list=WL) can trigger 'The playlist does not exist' error; subprocess invocation avoids this
quote: ERROR: [youtube:tab] WL: YouTube said: The playlist does not exist.

claim: Watch Later does not auto-remove watched videos; there is a manual Remove watched button; Made-for-kids videos cannot be added
quote: If the video is set as made for kids, you can't add it to a playlist or save it to Watch Later.

claim: HSID and SID together form Google's two-pronged defence, containing digitally signed records of Google Account ID and most recent sign-in time
quote: HSID cookies work together with SID as essential parts of Google's two-pronged defense strategy, containing digitally signed and encrypted records about a user's Google Account ID along with their most recent sign-in time.

claim: SAPISIDHASH is computed as SHA1 of concatenation of timestamp, SAPISID value, and https://www.youtube.com, formatted as {timestamp}_{hash}
quote: SAPISIDHASH...generated by creating a SHA1 hash of...{current_time} {sapisid} {origin}

claim: yt-dlp is the primary open-source YouTube downloader with 169k stars as of June 2026
bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider is a PO token plugin for yt-dlp using LuanRT's BotGuard library via HTTP server or CLI subprocess
quote: Proof-of-origin token provider plugin for yt-dlp

claim: yt-dlp-get-pot is an experimental plugin framework for yt-dlp to support fetching PO Tokens from external providers
quote: An experimental plugin framework for yt-dlp to support fetching PO Tokens from external providers
